title: Acyclicity of successive direct image on K-injectives
statement: Let f:X→Y and g:Y→Z be morphisms of ringed spaces [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Let I be any unbounded K-injective complex of O_X-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Write Q for localization of homotopy categories. With the module direct images and right-derived units of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], the component η_g(f_* I):Q(g_* f_* I)→Rg_*(Q(f_* I)) is an isomorphism. No flatness, boundedness, or K-injectivity of f_* I is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0D5S and 079W; the argument of Tag 0D5T restricted to K-injective representatives, including compatibility of derived and underived adjunctions

proof.text: Equip the source module category with the standard derived category; this is local to the proof. Let α=ηg(f*I) and β=Rg*(ηf(I)). The K-injective computation of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] makes ηf(I) invertible, and functors preserve isomorphisms, so β is invertible.

For an arbitrary T in D(O_Z), choose a complex G whose localization is isomorphic to T, using essential surjectivity of Q. Apply [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] to G to obtain a K-flat complex K and a quasi-isomorphism K→G. Its localization gives an isomorphism e:QK≅T. The Hom bijection of [lem-pc-ringed-space-pasted-unit-kflat-hom] for K implies the Hom bijection for T: injectivity follows after precomposition by e.hom and cancellation; for b:T→target lift e.hom≫b to a, then e.inv≫a is a preimage. Associativity and e.inv≫e.hom=id verify this.
Apply Mathlib isIso_of_yoneda_map_bijective to the pasted morphism α≫β. Since β is invertible, IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right cancels it and proves that α is invertible.
